evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: The hard tier rewards the recipe's pair structure, a deep rewrite against a minimal-edit near-miss: LLM rewrites alone score zero on it, attaching negatives unlocks it, and every negative that does so costs cross-language points; the sets scoring highest on it separate near-misses no LLM wrote worse than LLM rewrites with verified negatives.
